_why: Trade pack for Retail and sales. The first question is the disambiguator: retrieval pins the FAMILY, this settles which occupation within it, in the worker's own vocabulary.
_v2: REMOVES `tools_owned`. 'Kya aapke paas apne auzaar hain?' has no referent in a service, sales, care or supervision role — a cashier, a ward attendant and a security guard do not carry a tool kit to work, and every one of them was asked anyway. The item was never authored FOR this pack: Phase 6 (#615) stamped one shared four-question block onto every cluster it could not differentiate, and this is the row that block got wrong. An irrelevant question costs a paid provider call, one of 24 engine asks, and the worker's trust that the interview knows what they do.
review_note: v2 removes tools_owned (service cluster). v1 is deprecated in the same commit — the corpus validator refuses a second ACTIVE pack for one family+locale, because the resolver must never have to choose.
